attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The company is enumerated — twenty-seven men named one by one, with patronymics, birthplaces and the months of their deaths — so it is twenty-seven folders and not one, by docs/CORPUS.md §10.1. Nothing in the corpus answers to any of these surnames: a grep of `saints/` for all twenty-seven returned nothing, and no folder mentions Kharkov except `meletius-of-kharkov`, a bishop of the eighteen-hundreds. His own head line reads «Αγιος Παϊσιος ο Ιερομαρτυς (1869 - 1937)», and his sentence in the page's list is quoted whole in the life.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (30 September 2026).

death.note: saint.gr: «Ο Άγιος Ιερομάρτυς Παΐσιος Γρηγόρεβιτς Μόσκοτ, ο οποίος γεννήθηκε στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου 1869 στο χωριό Πέσκι Ραντκόφσκι της επαρχίας του Χάρκωβ και μαρτύρησε τον Οκτώβριο του 1937.»
